title: Jason & Lucia: what we know before day one
summary: Two protagonists, one couple. Mission walkthroughs land here from launch night.
body: GTA 6 follows Jason and Lucia across Vice City and Leonida. It is the first mainline GTA with a female lead protagonist.
Mission walkthroughs, gold-medal routes and choices that matter will be added here mission by mission after launch, without spoilers in the titles.
